definition: a plant that you eat, such as a carrot or a cabbage
exampleSentence: I eat vegetables every day.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ăn rau mỗi ngày.

definition: a long pointed orange vegetable that grows under the ground
exampleSentence: Rabbits like carrots.
exampleTranslation: Thỏ thích ăn cà rốt.

definition: a round vegetable with brown skin that grows under the ground
exampleSentence: Please peel the potatoes.
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn gọt vỏ khoai tây giúp tôi.

definition: a vegetable that looks like a red potato, is yellow inside, and tastes sweet
exampleSentence: We baked a sweet potato for dinner.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi nướng một củ khoai lang cho bữa tối.

definition: a tropical plant with thick roots that you can eat
exampleSentence: Cassava grows well in hot countries.
exampleTranslation: Khoai mì mọc tốt ở những nước nóng.

definition: a large round pale yellow vegetable that grows under the ground
exampleSentence: My grandmother cooks turnip soup.
exampleTranslation: Bà tôi nấu món canh củ cải.

definition: a small vegetable with a red or white root and a spicy taste
translation: củ cải đỏ, củ cải trắng
exampleSentence: I put a few radishes in the salad.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cho vài củ cải đỏ vào món salad.

definition: a plant with a round dark red root that you cook and eat
exampleSentence: Beetroot turns the soup red.
exampleTranslation: Củ dền làm món súp có màu đỏ.

definition: a round vegetable with many layers and a strong taste and smell
exampleSentence: Onions make me cry.
exampleTranslation: Hành tây làm tôi chảy nước mắt.

definition: an onion with a small white round part and a long green stem
exampleSentence: Add some chopped spring onion on top.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rắc thêm ít hành lá thái nhỏ lên trên.

definition: a vegetable like a small onion
exampleSentence: Fry the shallots until they are brown.
exampleTranslation: Hãy chiên hành tím cho đến khi vàng.

definition: a vegetable with a long white stem and flat green leaves, tasting like an onion
exampleSentence: I made a soup with leeks.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nấu một nồi súp với tỏi tây.

definition: a plant like a small onion, used in cooking to give a strong taste
exampleSentence: Add two cloves of garlic.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cho thêm hai tép tỏi.

definition: a root with a strong hot taste, used in cooking
exampleSentence: I put fresh ginger in my tea.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cho gừng tươi vào trà.

definition: a round soft red fruit that is eaten raw or cooked as a vegetable
exampleSentence: Slice the tomatoes for the sandwich.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cắt lát cà chua cho món bánh mì kẹp.

definition: a long thin vegetable with dark green skin, usually eaten raw
exampleSentence: I like cucumber in my salad.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích dưa leo trong món salad.

definition: a very large round orange vegetable that grows on the ground
exampleSentence: We made soup from a pumpkin.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi nấu súp từ một quả bí đỏ.

definition: a large vegetable with solid flesh and hard skin, such as a pumpkin
exampleSentence: Cut the squash in half.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cắt quả bí làm đôi.

definition: a long vegetable with dark green skin
exampleSentence: Slice the courgette into thin rounds.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cắt bí ngòi thành những lát tròn mỏng.

definition: a large dark purple vegetable
exampleSentence: Grill the aubergine for ten minutes.
exampleTranslation: Hãy nướng cà tím trong mười phút.

definition: a large vegetable with smooth purple skin
exampleSentence: My mother cooks eggplant with garlic.
exampleTranslation: Mẹ tôi nấu cà tím với tỏi.

definition: a hollow red, green, or yellow vegetable, eaten raw or cooked
exampleSentence: I cut a red pepper into strips.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cắt một quả ớt chuông đỏ thành sợi.

definition: a hollow red, green, or yellow vegetable
exampleSentence: I added a green bell pepper to the pasta.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cho thêm một quả ớt chuông xanh vào món mì Ý.

definition: a small thin red or green pepper with a very hot taste
exampleSentence: This soup has too much chilli.
exampleTranslation: Món súp này cho quá nhiều ớt.

definition: a large round vegetable with thick green or purple leaves
exampleSentence: We boiled some cabbage.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi luộc một ít bắp cải.

definition: a dark green vegetable with curled leaves
exampleSentence: Kale is good for you.
exampleTranslation: Cải xoăn rất tốt cho sức khỏe.

definition: a round vegetable with thin green leaves, eaten raw in salads
exampleSentence: Wash the lettuce before you eat it.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rửa xà lách trước khi ăn.

definition: a vegetable with large dark green leaves
exampleSentence: Children often do not like spinach.
exampleTranslation: Trẻ con thường không thích rau chân vịt.

definition: a plant with green leaves and a strong taste, eaten raw in salads
exampleSentence: I bought some rocket for the salad.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mua ít rau rocket để làm salad.

definition: a green vegetable that has short branch-like stems
translation: súp lơ xanh, bông cải xanh
exampleSentence: Steam the broccoli for five minutes.
exampleTranslation: Hãy hấp súp lơ xanh trong năm phút.

definition: a vegetable with green leaves around a firm white centre
translation: súp lơ trắng, bông cải trắng
exampleSentence: We had cauliflower with cheese.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn súp lơ trắng với phô mai.

definition: a long thin green vegetable with a point at one end
exampleSentence: Asparagus is nice with eggs.
exampleTranslation: Măng tây ăn rất hợp với trứng.

definition: a vegetable with long pale green stems that you can eat cooked or raw
exampleSentence: Cut the celery into small pieces.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cắt cần tây thành miếng nhỏ.

definition: a green vegetable used in cooking, especially in Asia and the southern US
exampleSentence: We cooked okra in a sour soup.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi nấu đậu bắp trong món canh chua.

definition: a tall plant with large yellow seeds, cooked and eaten as a vegetable
exampleSentence: We ate grilled corn at the market.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn bắp nướng ở chợ.

definition: the soft yellow seeds from maize that are cooked and eaten
exampleSentence: I put sweetcorn in the soup.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cho bắp ngọt vào súp.

definition: a small round green seed that is cooked and eaten as a vegetable
exampleSentence: The children like peas.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ thích ăn đậu Hà Lan.

definition: a seed or pod from a climbing plant, cooked and eaten as food
exampleSentence: We had rice and beans for lunch.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn cơm với đậu cho bữa trưa.

definition: a long thin green vegetable picked before the beans inside it grow
exampleSentence: Boil the green beans for three minutes.
exampleTranslation: Hãy luộc đậu que trong ba phút.

definition: a bean from an Asian plant used to make oil and food like tofu
exampleSentence: Tofu is made from soya beans.
exampleTranslation: Đậu hũ được làm từ đậu nành.

definition: a soft white food made from soya beans, used in cooking instead of meat
exampleSentence: I fried some tofu for dinner.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chiên đậu hũ cho bữa tối.

definition: a small round seed like a bean, dried and used for food
exampleSentence: Lentil soup is cheap and healthy.
exampleTranslation: Súp đậu lăng vừa rẻ vừa tốt cho sức khỏe.

definition: a large brown pea which is cooked and eaten
exampleSentence: I added chickpeas to the salad.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cho đậu gà vào món salad.

definition: the small white stem from a bean seed that is eaten as a vegetable
exampleSentence: Put some beansprouts in the noodle soup.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cho ít giá đỗ vào tô mì.

definition: a small green vegetable like a very small cabbage
exampleSentence: Do you want some sprouts with your dinner?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn ăn thêm cải Brussels với bữa tối không?

definition: a fungus with a stem and a round top that you can eat
exampleSentence: I like mushroom soup.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích súp nấm.

definition: a plant that grows in the sea and can be eaten
exampleSentence: Sushi is wrapped in seaweed.
exampleTranslation: Món sushi được cuốn bằng rong biển.

definition: a small bitter egg-shaped black or green fruit, used as food and for making oil
exampleSentence: Would you like some olives on your pizza?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn thêm ô liu lên bánh pizza không?

definition: a small plant used to give a better taste to food
exampleSentence: Sprinkle fresh herbs on the dish.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rắc rau thơm tươi lên món ăn.

definition: a herb with curly leaves, used in cooking or as decoration on food
exampleSentence: Chop some parsley for the sauce.
exampleTranslation: Hãy thái nhỏ ít mùi tây cho món sốt.

definition: a small plant with green leaves that have a fresh smell and taste
exampleSentence: I added fresh mint to my tea.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cho bạc hà tươi vào trà.

definition: a strong-smelling and strong-tasting herb used in cooking
exampleSentence: We use basil in tomato sauce.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi dùng húng quế trong sốt cà chua.

definition: a herb used especially in Asian and Mexican cooking
exampleSentence: Add some coriander before you serve it.
exampleTranslation: Hãy thêm ít rau mùi trước khi dọn món.

definition: the long thin green leaves of a plant that taste like onion
exampleSentence: Sprinkle chives over the eggs.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rắc hẹ lên trứng.

definition: a type of grass that grows in warm countries and is used in cooking
exampleSentence: The soup smells of lemon grass.
exampleTranslation: Món súp có mùi sả.

definition: a mixture of raw vegetables, especially lettuce, cucumber, and tomato
exampleSentence: Would you like some salad with your meal?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn ăn thêm salad với bữa ăn không?

definition: vegetables with large green leaves
exampleSentence: Eat your greens.
exampleTranslation: Hãy ăn rau xanh đi.

definition: the part of a plant that grows under the ground
exampleSentence: Carrots are root vegetables.
exampleTranslation: Cà rốt là loại rau củ.

definition: one of the flat green parts of a plant
exampleSentence: Remove the outer leaves of the cabbage.
exampleTranslation: Hãy bỏ những lá bên ngoài của bắp cải.

definition: a long narrow part of a plant that supports leaves, fruits, or flowers
exampleSentence: I need two stalks of celery.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần hai cọng cần tây.

definition: the long thin part of a plant, from which leaves or fruit grow
exampleSentence: Cut off the stems of the mushrooms.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cắt bỏ cuống nấm.

definition: a long narrow case that holds the seeds of plants such as peas and beans
exampleSentence: Open the pod and take out the peas.
exampleTranslation: Hãy bóc vỏ đậu và lấy hạt đậu ra.

definition: a small hard object from a plant, from which a new plant grows
exampleSentence: Plant the seeds in spring.
exampleTranslation: Hãy gieo hạt vào mùa xuân.

definition: fresh food has recently been picked or prepared and is not frozen or preserved
exampleSentence: These vegetables are fresh from the garden.
exampleTranslation: Những loại rau này vừa mới hái ngoài vườn.

definition: fully grown and ready to eat
exampleSentence: These tomatoes are not ripe yet.
exampleTranslation: Những quả cà chua này chưa chín.

definition: not cooked
exampleSentence: You can eat carrots raw.
exampleTranslation: Bạn có thể ăn cà rốt sống.

definition: grown without artificial chemicals
exampleSentence: I buy organic vegetables at the market.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mua rau hữu cơ ở chợ.

definition: a person who does not eat meat or fish
exampleSentence: My friend is a vegetarian.
exampleTranslation: Bạn tôi là người ăn chay.
